title: Igihugu cyanze gahunda karemano
intro: Mu karere inkuru yabayeho mu bihe bitandukanye, hari umuryango wabayeho mu bwigomeke ku mugaragaro ku mategeko y’ubuziranenge. Ibikorwa byabo byari bidasanzwe ku buryo byibukwa nk'umuburo ku bantu bose. Abo bantu bari bande, kandi ni iki cyabagezeho?
clues: Twatuye mu gihugu kiri hafi y'inzira abagenzi bakundaga kunyuramo, ariko urugendo rwabo twararugize akaga.
Twakoze ibikorwa by'ubuhemu nta muntu n'umwe wigeze akora mbere.
Intumwa yaturutse muri twe yaraduhamagaye ngo tureke inzira zacu, ariko twaramwanze kandi dusaba igihano niba yari umunyakuri.
Ubwo abashyitsi beza bazaga mu mujyi wacu, twashakaga kubatera, tutazi ko ari intumwa zo kurimbura.
Twaburiwe igihano gikomeye nitudacika intege, ariko twasetse umuburo maze tuguma mu byaha byacu.
Imvura y'amabuye yaturutse mu ijuru yaratuguyeho, amazu yacu arasenyuka, nta n'umwe wasize uretse ikimenyetso ku batekereza.

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Yakoze ubusambanyi budasanzwe n'imihanda idafite aho ihuriye
Yashutswe mu bucuruzi kandi yagabanyije abaturage amafaranga
Yubatse umunara muremure kugira ngo agerageze ijuru
trial.answer: Yakoze ubusambanyi budasanzwe n'imihanda idafite aho ihuriye

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Yasenywe n'imvura y'amabuye yaturutse mu ijuru
outcome.answer: Yasenywe n'imvura y'amabuye yaturutse mu ijuru

arabic: إِنَّا مُنزِلُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ رِجْزًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verse: Indeed, we will bring down on the people of this city punishment from the sky because they have been defiantly disobedient." (29:34)
